final: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_rate_difference FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_difference) AS overall_avg FROM fee_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_rebate), AVG(g.avg_rate_difference), AVG(g.avg_rate_difference - o.overall_avg) FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_rate_difference > o.overall_avg
